name: A student retains separate citizenship and residence and a private application plan
description: The configured isolated student saves a final-year profile, receives explainable matches, and retains application notes and progress after signing out and returning.

planSteps.description: Sign in using the student account configured on this project environment, then navigate to /settings/profile. If the Your world stage is not selected, click Your world.
Set Citizenship(s) to Nigeria and Country of residence to Ghana. Click Save & continue and wait for Current qualification. Reload /settings/profile and click Your world.

Required residence-clearing checkpoint: verify saved Ghana is selected in Country of residence. Click the Remove Ghana button within that field. Verify the selected Ghana chip disappears and the Country of residence input is empty. Fail if this checkpoint was not actually performed; typing over the value is not a substitute.
Reselect Ghana as Country of residence and click Save & continue. Continue the existing final-year profile and saved application journey.
Set Current qualification to bachelor, Completion status to final_year, and Actual or expected graduation to 2027-06-01. Click Save & continue.
Set Intended future qualification to master and Intended field of study to Computer Science. Click Save & continue, then Save & see my matches.
On the dashboard, if Update my matches is available click it and wait until assessment updating finishes.
Verify explained opportunity results include Potential · confirm requirements, without labelling every missing provider condition eligible.
Navigate to /scholarships/twente-uts-2027. If Save scholarship is shown, click it. If Unsave scholarship is already shown, keep it saved.
Expand My application plan. Set My application progress to Preparing documents and Private notes to TestSprite verification: confirm provider language requirements. Click Save my plan.
Verify Your plan is saved. Reload, expand My application plan, and verify progress remains Preparing documents and the exact private note remains saved. Verify the provider window still says Open.
Sign out, sign in again with the configured project account, and navigate to /settings/profile. Select Your world if necessary.
Verify Citizenship(s) remains Nigeria and Country of residence remains Ghana.
Verify the Twente scholarship appears in the Preparing documents personal application stage.
